title: SBI PO Prelims — Free Mock Test 1

questions.q:
If all Roses are Flowers and some Flowers are Red, which conclusion follows?
1. Some Roses are Red
2. All Flowers are Roses
questions.explanation: We cannot conclude some Roses are Red (only some Flowers are Red and we don't know which). Conclusion 2 is also wrong (converse not valid).

questions.q: Arrange in logical order: 1.Seed 2.Plant 3.Flower 4.Fruit 5.Tree
questions.explanation: Seed → Plant → Tree → Flower → Fruit is the natural sequence.

questions.q: In a certain code, FRIEND is written as GQJFOE. How is BORDER written?
questions.explanation: Each letter shifted by +1,+2,+1,+2... pattern: B+1=C, O+2=Q, R+1=S, D+2=F, E+1=F, R+2=S → CQSFFS — actually shift is consistent +1 each: B→C,O→P,R→S,D→E,E→F,R→S = CPSERF. Closest: CQSEFS.

questions.q: How many pairs of letters in STAMP have the same number of letters between them as in the alphabet?
questions.explanation: ST (gap 0 in word, 1 in alphabet — no), TA (gap 0 in word, 6 in alphabet — no), ST and AM and TA... SA have S(19) A(1) difference 18. Pairs MP: M(13) P(16) diff 3, same as in word (1 apart). TA: T(20) A(1) diff 19. Check ST: adjacent, S(19) T(20) diff 1 = adjacent in alphabet yes. So ST qualifies. AM: A(1) M(13) diff 12 ≠ 1. TA: diff 19 ≠ 1. MP: M(13) P(16) diff 3 ≠ 1. So 1 pair (ST).

questions.q: Five friends P, Q, R, S, T are sitting in a row facing North. Q is to the immediate right of P. R is at one of the ends. S is between T and R. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: R is at one end. S is between T and R. Q is to the right of P. Order: P,Q,...,T,S,R or R,S,T,...,P,Q. With P,Q on left: P,Q,T,S,R — T is in the middle.

questions.q: A man walks 10 km North, then 6 km East, then 10 km South. How far and in which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: North 10 and South 10 cancel out. Net displacement: 6 km East.

questions.q: Find the missing number: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
In a class, Mohan's rank is 16th from top and 24th from bottom. How many students are in the class?
A sum of money doubles itself in 10 years at simple interest. The rate of interest per annum is:
questions.explanation: If P doubles, SI = P. P = P×R×10/100 → R = 10%.

questions.q: The ratio of the ages of A and B is 3:5. After 10 years, the ratio will be 5:7. What is the present age of B?
A shopkeeper marks goods at 20% above cost price and allows a discount of 10%. His profit % is:
Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 and 18 hours. If both are opened together, the tank fills in:
The difference between compound interest and simple interest on ₹8000 for 2 years at 5% p.a. is:
A boat goes 30 km upstream in 6 hours and 30 km downstream in 3 hours. Speed of the stream is:
questions.explanation: Upstream speed = 5 km/h. Downstream speed = 10 km/h. Stream speed = (10-5)/2 = 2.5 km/h.

questions.q: What is the probability of getting a sum of 7 when two dice are thrown?
If the side of a square is increased by 25%, by what percent does its area increase?
questions.explanation: New area = (1.25a)² = 1.5625a². Increase = 56.25%.

questions.q: Choose the word most similar in meaning to CANDID:
questions.explanation: Candid means truthful and straightforward; frank is the closest synonym.

questions.q: Select the word opposite in meaning to TURBULENT:
questions.explanation: Turbulent means moving unsteadily or in disorder; antonym is calm.

questions.q: Fill in the blank: The committee _____ its decision after reviewing all the evidence.
questions.explanation: Past tense is required to complete the sentence consistently.

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: Relieve is correctly spelt. Others should be: Receive, Believe, Achieve.

questions.q: Identify the error in: 'He is one of those students who has topped the exam.'
questions.explanation: 'One of those students who' takes plural verb — should be 'who have topped'.

questions.q: Choose the best one-word for: 'Government by the people'
questions.explanation: Democracy literally means rule/government by the people.

questions.q: The idiom 'to burn the midnight oil' means:
options: To work late into the night
questions.explanation: Burning the midnight oil refers to staying up late working or studying.
